text: Polarization is all around you. Polarizing sunglasses: glare from water and roads is mostly horizontally polarized, so the lenses pass only vertical vibrations. Camera filters that darken the sky and remove reflections. The LCD screen of every calculator and phone, which works by twisting polarized light between crossed sheets. 3 D films, where each eye gets light polarized at right angles. Engineers' stress analysis, where a plastic model of a bridge glows with coloured fringes between crossed Polaroids. And simple, smooth light dimmers.
